notes.title: Small update: Added Chickens, many bug fixes, and more
notes.notes:
Kill chickens, get raw chicken, cook it at a cauldron, get cooked chicken 📈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41638708/a57f372f759268b25a5d7b2ac2e9323b45fe8e65.png[/img]

[h2]Other stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ctrl + click in chest/inventory menu automatically switches the item to chest or vice-versa
[*] Close most menus with tab
[*] Special easter egg when you talk to the goblins in local chat
[*] new user name tags for other players and goblins, and chat boxes for local chat
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41638708/141dbe66e1f2744684e80cd48386c0116e4be01a.png[/img]
[h2]Many bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Mithril was essentially non-existant
[*] Slingshot works again
[*] Won't show block shape controls if you can't change block shape
[*] Fixed furnace ore/ingot showing up weird if when you have bags equipped
[*] Fixed draw speed on slingshot and bows
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.20 Mini update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Player made assets are now included in the game build (which you download from Steam) so new players won't have to wait for a while for assets to download
[*] Re-added all enemies to dungeons that were missing enemies
[*] Fixed multiple game servers support
[*] Made coord display more visible and added the level of the area to it
[*] Improvements and fixes to main menu
[*] You can now easily see player spawn in dungeon builder
[*] Dungeon builder submit instructions fixed
[*] Disconnect to main menu if you lose connection to the server while in a dungeon
[*] Tweaks for Fozo event
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where enemies could not navigate to players in dungeons
[*] Fixed bug where players would fall through checkpoint when respawning in dungeon
[*] Fixed bug where builder would warn you couldn't place an item when you actually could
[/list]

notes.title: New Crafting System - First Update
notes.notes:
💀[b][b]The skeleton is now made entirely of blocks and every bone is editable.[/b]💀
⚒Crafting is now done on a crafting table.[/b]⚒
📈[b]Blocks give items stats.[/b] So instead of there being stone axe, copper axe, etc. you now craft a "stick" and it does more damage depending on what blocks you add to it. Stone and ingots will make an axe do more damage and give you more protection but will also add weight to your skelly and will slow you down if you add too much! There are several other stat types and I plan on adding many more. To learn about all of the current stats you can ask Krob about them!
📐🔵🟦[b]Switch between block shapes whenever you want with all blocks![/b]🟦🔵📐

As I said in the last message, I had to delete all the existing crafted items because they weren't compatible with the new system. But I still have everyone's blueprints and I will work on getting those working again [b]so your old work will not be lost[/b]!

Also on 12/30 the community will be hosting another fashion show 📸 with the theme ❄️ Winter / Holidays 
Use the new creative freedom to show off your crafting skills!! Join the Discord for more info!

💚I am so appreciative of all of you and your support in these early days of Skullborn's development
Skullborn will be 40% off during the Steam Winter Sale! So tell your friends and let's make the world of Skullborn grow!💚

Happy Holidays!! 🎅

notes.title: RELEASE DELAYED UNTIL NOV 5
notes.notes:
Hey guys, Valve needs to review Skullborn before I can release it and it's taking longer than expected so it's looking like I'm not going to be able to release the game tomorrow.

Nothing is changing, you will still be able to play the demo until then. And this will just give me more time to improve the Early Access version of the game and market it more!

And I want to add that many people still haven't discovered the easter egg with the Jack-o-lisk is that you can ride him around if you break off all of his tail chunks and you can ride him with other players. So maybe give that a shot!
